TEMPLATE_PIPELINE.description: Defects originating in the 5-item rotation template engine that produced all original content
defects: DL-012: Section E clonal redundancy (140 clones)
DL-016: Metadata-block topic shift (58 Certified + all sections)
DL-021: Missing distractor EW fields (100 items)
DL-025: Empty non-CC EW slots (56 items)
DL-026: Empty non-CC slots cross-pool (1,005 items)
template_pipeline_characteristics: 5-item rotation groups: stems identical except company name, CorrectChoice rotates A→B→C→D→A
Difficulty labels assigned by position in rotation, not by cognitive assessment
Distractor explanations generated from boilerplate templates ('represents a plausible misconception')
All 4 ExplanationWrong slots filled identically without checking CorrectChoice position
Metadata blocks carry stale rotation-template residue independent of content blocks
Topic labels auto-incremented without content verification
No post-generation quality check beyond structural validation

AUTHOR_ERROR.description: Individual item-level authoring errors, not systematic
defects: DL-007: Generic distractor explanation (1 item → superseded by DL-013)
DL-009: Wrong ASC authority citation (10 items)
DL-023: Case exhibit headers missing (17 exhibits)

CODE_DEFECT.description: Application-layer bugs in app.js, validators, or tooling
defects: DL-022: Null-array crash on corrupted restore

PROCESS_METHODOLOGY.description: Cross-session, tooling, or methodology bugs in remediation pipeline
defects: DL-033: Naming confusion (Pack E vs Pack A Section E)

defect_origin_analysis.critical_insight: 53% of all defect classes trace to a single root cause: the template-rotation authoring pipeline. This pipeline produced 2,500 items but also generated 19 classes of structural and content defects that required hundreds of hours of remediation. Any new authoring system must eliminate the template-rotation approach entirely.

quality_first_pipeline.design_principle: Every item is a discrete product of a quality-assured sequence. No bulk generation. No template rotation. No position-based labeling.

stage_1_blueprint.name: Blueprint Anchoring
stage_1_blueprint.input: CMA Part 1 CSO Learning Outcome Statement
activities: Select specific LOS from official IMA blueprint
Determine cognitive level (Remember→Evaluate) per LOS verb
Identify topic, subtopic, domain
Select formula reference if applicable
Document accounting principle to be tested
stage_1_blueprint.quality_gate: LOS must be selectable from IMA blueprint. CognitiveLevel must match LOS verb. Topic must exist in TAXONOMY_REGISTRY.md.
stage_1_blueprint.failure_mode_prevention: Prevents DL-031 (miscalibration) and DL-032 (uniform labeling) by anchoring difficulty to LOS verb before writing begins

stage_2_stem.name: Stem Authoring
activities: Write business scenario with named company, stakeholder, business trigger
Include all numerical data needed for calculation (if applicable)
Ensure scenario is self-contained but not definitional
For Analyze items: scenario must require comparison, interpretation, or pattern identification
For Evaluate items: scenario must involve judgment under ambiguity or trade-off assessment
Check: stem must NOT be a textbook definition followed by a term-identification question
stage_2_stem.quality_gate: Stem must be unique within section. Must use business language (CAQS §3.2). Must not match definition-match pattern (DL-031). For Analyze+: must require interpretation beyond single-step calculation.
stage_2_stem.failure_mode_prevention: Prevents DL-001 (imprecise wording), DL-031 (definition-match), DL-004 (ambiguity) by requiring business-context scenario, not textbook framing

stage_3_correct_reasoning.name: Correct Reasoning Path
activities: Solve independently — do not read stored answer
Document complete solution: formula → substitution → result → interpretation
Reference authoritative source (ASC, COSO, IAS, IMA) by correct section number
For Analyze items: document the analysis pattern (comparison framework, trend logic, root-cause chain)
For Evaluate items: document the judgment criteria and decision rule
Verify arithmetic independently
stage_3_correct_reasoning.output: CORRECT_REASONING: {Formula, Substitution, Result, Principle, Authority, Interpretation}
stage_3_correct_reasoning.quality_gate: Calculation must be independently verified. ASC/COSO citation must match actual standard scope (prevents DL-009). For Apply+: business interpretation required.
stage_3_correct_reasoning.failure_mode_prevention: Prevents DL-009 (wrong authority), DL-030 (wrong answer key), DL-001 (imprecise wording) by requiring independent solve before answer registration

stage_4_distractor_logic.name: Distractor Engineering
activities: For each distractor (3 per item):
1. Identify a specific, named misconception (e.g., 'confuses cash vs. accrual basis')
2. Construct a choice text that would attract a candidate with that misconception
3. Write an ExplanationWrong that: names the error, explains the misconception, contrasts with correct approach
4. Verify explanation is choice-specific (prevents DL-007/DL-013)
Confirm: all 3 distractors target distinct errors
Confirm: no distractor matches the correct answer in category
For the correct-answer slot: ExplanationWrong[CC] = '' (empty — DL-008 compliance)
stage_4_distractor_logic.output: DISTRACTOR_SET: {Choice + ExplanationWrong for A, B, C, D} + CorrectChoice
stage_4_distractor_logic.quality_gate: All 3 distractors must be choice-specific (no copy-paste). Each must name a distinct misconception. ExplanationWrong[CC] must be ''. Each slot must reference the item's own Choices text (not metadata-block ChoiceA-D). Minimum 50 characters per field. No 'represents a plausible misconception' template language.
stage_4_distractor_logic.failure_mode_prevention: Prevents DL-007/DL-013 (generic explanations), DL-008 (non-empty CC slot), DL-010 (misassigned), DL-016 (metadata-content mismatch), DL-021 (absent fields), DL-025/DL-026 (empty distractor slots), DL-027 (closing-tag boilerplate)

stage_5_evidence_review.name: Evidence Review
activities: Verify CorrectChoice against independent solution (Stage 3)
Verify ExplanationCorrect contains all required elements (CAQS §4.1)
Verify all 4 ExplanationWrong fields present and type-correct
Verify ExplanationWrong[CC] is empty string (not absent, not non-empty)
Verify all distractor ExplanationWrong fields are non-empty and >= 50 chars
Verify ASC/COSO citations match item topic
Verify Difficulty and DifficultyScore match cognitive demand
Verify CognitiveLevel matches LOS verb
Run governance guard Rule 2, Rule 6 checks
Verify item renders correctly in minimal test harness
stage_5_evidence_review.output: EVIDENCE_REVIEW_REPORT: {All checks, PASS/FAIL per check, confidence score}
stage_5_evidence_review.quality_gate: All checks must PASS. Zero DL-008. Zero DL-026. Zero DL-009. Zero DL-010. Confidence >= 95.
stage_5_evidence_review.failure_mode_prevention: Catches all 19 template-pipeline defect classes before item enters certification pipeline. Gate-based — an item cannot accidentally pass through.

stage_6_certification.name: Certification
activities: Six-dimension AI verification (CAQS §1.6): Correctness, Precision, Difficulty Calibration, Distractor Engineering, Blueprint Alignment, CMA Part 1 Relevance
All six must be HIGH confidence
Record distractor tier map (A/B/C/D)
Set question_state = 'Certified'
Update REVISION_HISTORY.md
Re-run governance guard
stage_6_certification.quality_gate: CAQS §1.7.2: All 6 dimensions HIGH confidence. Governance guard 32/32 PASS. REVISION_HISTORY.md entry written.

quality_first_pipeline.pipeline_diagram: Blueprint → Stem → Correct Reasoning → Distractor Logic → Evidence Review → Certification
anti_patterns_eliminated: Template rotation groups (DL-012, DL-015, DL-016, DL-024)
Missing field authoring (DL-018, DL-021, DL-024, DL-034)

quality_gates_summary.stage_1: Blueprint anchored to IMA CSO; cognitive level matches LOS verb
quality_gates_summary.stage_2: Business-context stem; not definition-match; self-contained scenario data
quality_gates_summary.stage_3: Independent solve; correct ASC/COSO citation; verified arithmetic
quality_gates_summary.stage_4: Choice-specific distractor explanations; distinct misconception per distractor; CC-slot empty
quality_gates_summary.stage_5: Full structural + content verification; all governance rules pass; confidence >= 95
quality_gates_summary.stage_6: All 6 CAQS dimensions HIGH confidence; certified into learner pool
